question: What realized funding cashflow would have applied to the frozen efficient-trend Binance positions at their already-fixed quantities and holding clocks?

source_account.source_paths: yoyo.evaluation.cloud_close_efficiency_binance_bounds._accounting_legs; exact selected native VectorBT leg prices, quantities, phases and clocks

ada.description: One focal large ADA position, both frozen child legs, for validating the oldest high-impact held interval before broad extension.

all.description: All 1,629 originally defined funded Binance positions only; no newly added historical tickers or replacement account.

funding_source.query_unit: one bounded actual-held window per symbol-month; paginate by observed fundingTime until the API returns an empty page
exact_source_priority: Existing Binance normalized history only when its manifest covers the full query and rate/mark fields are complete
Binance public fundingRate response with exact fundingTime, fundingRate and markPrice
Official monthly Binance fundingRate archive joined to the official mark-price hourly open as an explicitly tagged proxy
funding_source.fallback: Reuse local funding and mark archives first. If a needed funding or mark file is missing, call monday_breadth_opt_funding.archive_month for that exact symbol-month; it fetches the official monthly mark-price 1h archive and daily mark hours missing from that month archive.
funding_source.missing_policy: Do not fill missing rates or prices with zero. Preserve unknown settlement rows and incomplete position totals; successful API empty ranges are separately labeled as no settlement rows returned.

cashflow.boundary_rule: When fundingTime is within one second of entry_ms or exit_bar_ms, report an include/exclude cashflow interval ordered by sign. Interior settlement rows are deterministic. Preserve actual exit_phase on every child leg.
cashflow.mark_proxy: Official Binance USD-M markPriceKlines 1h open at the fundingTime hour; set mark_source=binance_vision_mark_1h_open_proxy.
cashflow.schedule: Use observed fundingTime timestamps and report 1h/4h/8h/other interval counts per symbol-month. Never assume a fixed cadence.
cashflow.unknowns: If any required symbol-month lacks a complete rate range or any observed settlement lacks rate/mark, report known subtotal but null complete lower/upper totals.

limits: This is a funding cashflow sensitivity on frozen position sizes and clocks, not a new strategy backtest.
No account replay, reinvestment, NAV compounding, or new funded-position selection is performed.
The all scope is restricted to the original 1,629 funded Binance positions; later historical-contract repairs are excluded.
